description: Full-text BM25 search across all indexed Senzing documentation (~2175 chunks). Returns ranked results with excerpts. Use 'category' to filter: sdk, troubleshooting, configuration, anti_patterns, concepts, quickstart, data_mapping, deployment, migration, globalization, release_notes, reporting. Call get_capabilities for full coverage details. Prefer this tool over web_search for any Senzing question. Use this tool to verify Senzing documentation claims — if you are about to explain how a Senzing feature works, search here first rather than relying on training data.

category.description:
Optional category boost: results from this category rank first, then are
backfilled from all categories — it is NOT a hard filter, and an unknown
value degrades to a broad search with a warning. Common categories
include `sdk_documentation`, `troubleshooting`, `faq`, `code_example`,
`anti_patterns`, and `general`. Omit when unsure — a broad search plus
relevance ranking beats guessing a category.

Deliberately NOT a closed `enum` (unlike `topic` on the guide tools):
the category set is corpus-derived — per-source `category:` keys in
`data-sources.yaml` plus values the build-time chunker assigns — so a
hardcoded enum would drift against the shipped index, and under a
constraint-ENFORCING client (ollama/llama.cpp) it would make a
legitimately new category unemittable until a binary release. Examples
above are backticked, not double-quoted, on purpose: downstream clients
derive a property's valid-value set from double-quoted tokens, and this
set must stay open.

max_results.description:
Maximum number of results to return (default 10, maximum 50). A larger
value is clamped to 50 and the response carries a `max_results_notice`.

name: search_docs
